summary: Verified the new Emergent-managed Resend email notifications wired into POST /api/quotes and POST /api/contact. Full regression pytest suite (18/18) still green. Independent live verification: submitted quote (q_59a5385e246d) via ingress → HTTP 201 in <1s, response body {ok:true,quote_id:'q_...',message:'Thanks — ...'}; within ~1s /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log contained the exact line `bernat - INFO - Email sent to alex@bernatsolutions.com (subject=New quote enquiry — Agent Co (q_59a5385e246d))`. Contact submission (m_8c8a3e311129) → HTTP 201 {ok:true,message_id:'m_...'}; log line `bernat - INFO - Email sent to alex@bernatsolutions.com (subject=New contact message — Testing Agent)` observed. Send-path source assertions: EMAIL_BASE_URL is the hardcoded constant 'https://integrations.emergentagent.com' in server.py:65 (not env-driven). Payload keys built in _send_email(): to (list), subject, html, from_name (== EMAIL_FROM_NAME == 'Bernat Solutions'), and contact_email set to the enquirer email when reply_to is provided. `grep -c 'from_name' server.py` = 1 (>=1 OK), `grep -c 'EMAIL_FROM_NAME' server.py` = 2 (>=2 OK). Frontend e2e: /quote submitted end-to-end (ref q_c5ecc4dca4c6) → quote-success testid visible with q_ reference; /contact submitted → contact-success testid visible. All test data cleaned up via admin DELETE + mongosh deleteMany.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:319 _send_email is correctly fire-and-forget-safe: httpx errors are caught (HTTPStatusError + generic) and logged, never bubbled; a request to /api/quotes or /api/contact cannot be delayed or 500'd by an email proxy outage.

server.py:476 _fire_and_forget uses asyncio.get_running_loop().create_task(coro) inside the request handler — correct pattern; task keeps running after the response is sent because the event loop is the app-wide loop, not the request scope.
Reply-To semantics: the Emergent proxy contract uses 'contact_email' as the Reply-To surrogate — implementation matches spec (payload['contact_email'] = reply_to when provided).

Minor (non-blocking) — the reply_to param is set to the enquirer email for both endpoints; the Pydantic ContactMessage validates email format but the quote form uses EmailStr on Form(...), which is also validated. No injection risk into headers because Resend proxy handles header construction server-side.
Optional future hardening: record a metric/audit row in Mongo when email send fails (currently only logged) so ops can retry stuck notifications.
